title_lines: 芯片成本压力传导至终端

subtitles.en: TSMC obviously taking this step because it needs to to fund its ambitions, right?
subtitles.zh: 台积电显然在采取这一步，因为它需要资金来实现其雄心，对吧？

subtitles.en: How will it impact the spenders? TSMC is reacting well, but I can't imagine it's good news for everybody.
subtitles.zh: 这对支出者有何影响？台积电反应良好，但我无法想象这对所有人都是好消息。

subtitles.en: Yeah, I mean, I think obviously this is going to put upward pressure on Nvidia chips and maybe on Apple products. Obviously, you've seen recently Apple prices up, so you know, we're still living in
subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为这显然会给英伟达芯片和苹果产品带来上行压力。最近苹果产品价格上涨，我们仍处于通胀环境中。

subtitles.en: an inflationary environment. So, yeah, ultimately, I think perhaps one way we'll see this is maybe some more upward pressure in the capital spending budgets for the hyperscalers. I've also got Google
subtitles.zh: 所以，最终我们可能会看到超大规模企业的资本支出预算面临更多上行压力。谷歌本周晚些时候也将发布财报，资本支出肯定是关注重点。

subtitles.en: reporting late this week and definitely CapEx will want to be one of the items that people are focused on. So, I think that's kind of how it would perhaps initially kind of flow through.
subtitles.zh: 这可能是最初传导的方式。

subtitles.en: You know, and ultimately maybe the end consumer is going to have to bear higher costs whether that's through hardware costs or through the cost of using AI products and services. Obviously, we've seen
subtitles.zh: 最终，终端消费者可能不得不承担更高的成本，无论是通过硬件成本还是使用AI产品和服务的成本。

subtitles.en: a lot of upward pressure on token costs for corporates and some of them being pulling back.
subtitles.zh: 我们看到企业代币成本面临很大上行压力，有些企业正在缩减。

subtitles.en: So, it's going to be potentially a bit of a squeeze there between how they're like to say open AI and anthropic can price their products and the rate at which customers adopt those products into their
subtitles.zh: 因此，在OpenAI和Anthropic如何为其产品定价以及客户采用这些产品的速度之间，可能会出现一些挤压。

clip_research.source_claim: TSMC is in talks to raise prices up to 10% next year, which will put upward pressure on Nvidia chips and Apple products, and ultimately end consumers may bear higher costs.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public snippets indicate TSMC plans to raise chipmaking prices by up to 10% in 2027, not next year (2025). The year discrepancy is significant.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The clip says 'next year' (presumably 2025) but public reports consistently say 2027. This is a major timeline mismatch.

evidence.fact: Nikkei reports TSMC to raise prices by up to 10% from 2027, not 2025.
Reuters confirms TSMC price hike in 2027.
Bloomberg reports TSMC in talks for 2027 price increase.

forbidden_claims: The impact on consumers is certain

notes: The clip's claim of 'next year' (2025) contradicts public reports that the price increase is planned for 2027. This is a critical factual error that should be highlighted.
The speaker's analysis of upward pressure on Nvidia, Apple, and end consumers is speculative and not directly supported by the public snippets.
